E_FAB.fact_summary_en: ABS parts made by fused-filament three-dimensional printing; no printer recipe supplied.

E_CELLS.fact_summary_en: Six tapered labyrinthine cell types. Approximately pi/6 adjacent phase difference at 3000 Hz. Single-layer reflection and double-layer transmission are distinct configurations.

E_GEOM.fact_summary_en: Drawn outlines measure 36 mm along the illustrated propagation direction and 25 mm across. Spiral angles: 135, 180, 270, 450, 495, 540 degrees. Period 150 mm; eight periods; displayed transmissive array has two layers. Not full CAD.

E_NORMAL.locator: Figure 2a-c and preceding Results on page 2
E_NORMAL.fact_summary_en: Measured normal-incidence maps compare absent array, low and high phase-gradient arrays at 3000 Hz. Reported gradients are 3.3 and 6.7 times 2pi rad/m.

E_GUIDE.fact_summary_en: Parallel plates separated by 50.8 mm. Map begins at source coordinate y=40 cm, 3.4 cm after the array exit. These coordinates do not define a full scan grid.

E_BAND.fact_summary_en: Low-gradient array measured at 2800, 3000 and 3200 Hz. Similar pattern and angle are reported without a numeric equivalence tolerance.

E_NEAR.fact_summary_en: At 25 degrees, measured near-interface pressure is spatially transformed and compared with a simulated spectrum and free-space reference; interpreted as localized driven evanescence.

E_SCATTER.fact_summary_en: Numerical scattered-field comparison uses incident angles 20 and 10 degrees; reported scattered fractions are respectively 27.8 and 89.0 percent.

E_SWEEP.fact_summary_en: Measured and simulated transmitted-angle dependence is compared with generalized refraction plus diffraction. Complete measured schedule is plotted rather than tabulated.

E_POLAR.fact_summary_en: Measured and simulated radiation patterns at 5, 20 and 35 degrees. Measured display normalized using corresponding simulated maxima; possible fabrication-related side lobe is a tentative interpretation.

E_NEGATIVE.fact_summary_en: Measured and numerical maps at 45 degrees illustrate apparent negative refraction associated with higher diffraction order, not a bulk negative-index measurement.

E_SETUP.fact_summary_en: 18 PUI AS07108PO-3-R speakers, Pyle PCA3 amplifier, microphone with embedded preamplifier, NI PCI-6251 DAQ and two-dimensional linear stage. Broadband Gaussian pulse; pointwise time signals transformed to complex pressure.

E_NUM.fact_summary_en: COMSOL finite-element calculations with effective acoustic parameter retrieval; field model approximates two-dimensional apparatus and uses plane-wave radiation boundaries.

E_SNELL.locator: Equation 1 and Results; critical-angle passage page 3
E_SNELL.fact_summary_en: Model: (sin(theta_t)-sin(theta_i))*k0=xi. Reported lower critical angle for high gradient is 13.7 degrees. These are theoretical expectations.

E_DIFFRACTION.fact_summary_en: Model extends phase gradient by nG*G; ordinary branch nG=0 and the reported high-angle branch nG=-3 for this design.

E_LOSSLESS.fact_summary_en: Lossless numerical case at 25 degrees reflects over 80 percent. Driven surface response is not an interface eigenmode.

E_LOSSY.fact_summary_en: Lossy illustration is labeled 25 degrees. Air index 1-0.02i within array region; parameter selected to match measured 10-degree transmission. Note reports 27.8 percent scattered energy; retain separate from main angle labels.

E_COUPLE.fact_summary_en: Numerical-only corrugated guide, 2.5 cm period and sound-hard boundaries, couples driven mode to propagating eigen-surface mode under 20-degree incidence.

E_ORDER.fact_summary_en: Diffraction-order analysis identifies upper transition near 31.6 degrees for reported design; scalar model limitations at larger angles retained.

E_REFS.fact_summary_en: Prior literature supplies theoretical context. Cited apparatus/retrieval papers were not treated as a recovered complete recipe.
